Usage: resecta-data build fuzz [OPTIONS] {redos|pdf-mutations}

  Build fuzz payload catalogs.

Options:
  --build-dir DIRECTORY  [required]
  --seed INTEGER         [default: 20260416]
  --packet FILE          Source PDF the pdf-mutations kind damages (a sample-doc checkout's
                         packet.pdf). Required for that kind; ignored otherwise. Nothing binary is
                         committed here -- the base is read at build time and its sha256 is recorded
                         in the manifest.
  --count INTEGER        How many pdf-mutations fixtures to emit, split evenly across the four
                         families.  [default: 100]
  --help                 Show this message and exit.
